task: Search for the paper 'ResNet: Enabling Deep Convolutional Neural Networks through Residual Learning' in Google Chrome and download it as a PDF. Save the PDF to /home/user/Downloads/resnet_paper.pdf.

verification.command: check-file-contains /home/user/Downloads/resnet_paper.pdf "ResNet: Enabling Deep Convolutional Neural Networks through Residual Learning"
verification.description: PDF contains 'ResNet: Enabling Deep Convolutional Neural Networks through Residual Learning' in the title
